claims: Monitor serum potassium given hyperkalemia (5.1 mEq/L) and active potassium replacement orders.
Monitor coagulation parameters (PT/INR/PTT) given elevated PTT (114.5 sec) and ongoing heparin infusion.
Monitor lactate trend given elevated lactate (3.0 mmol/L, improving to 2.1 mmol/L).
Monitor hemoglobin and hematocrit given anemia (Hgb 9.3-9.4 g/dL, Hct 29.2-30.4%).
Monitor heart rate and rhythm given tachycardia (HR up to 145 bpm) and digoxin administration.
Monitor oxygen saturation and respiratory status given borderline SpO2 (96-98%) and tachypnea (RR 20-23).
Monitor mental status and delirium screening given CAM-ICU MS change positive and fluctuating orientation.
Monitor renal function and electrolytes (BUN 32 mg/dL, creatinine 1.0 mg/dL, bicarbonate 18-21 mEq/L).
Continue heparin infusion with monitoring of anticoagulation effect.
Maintain fall precautions given high fall risk (history of falling, walker use, weakness).
